message:
Using `on:panstart` to listen to the panstart event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onpanstart` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:panmove` to listen to the panmove event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onpanmove` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:panend` to listen to the panend event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onpanend` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated
